title: Eddie Edwards vs. Sami Callihan: revenge takes over
summary: A baseball-bat attack turns Eddie Edwards’ rivalry with Sami Callihan into an obsession. Eddie’s pursuit of revenge alienates the people trying to help him and changes his on-screen identity.

chapters.title: Callihan’s bat attack
chapters.result: After losing to Edwards, Callihan attacks him with a baseball bat.
chapters.context: The televised attack becomes the starting point for an increasingly personal feud. The milestone uses the broadcast date.

chapters.title: The fight moves into the woods
chapters.result: Edwards and Callihan brawl in an unsanctioned filmed confrontation.
chapters.context: Eddie overwhelms Callihan but will not stop. Alisha and Tommy Dreamer try to intervene, and Eddie strikes Dreamer, showing how revenge has consumed him.
